name: Score and route GoHighLevel leads with Gemini, Slack and Monday.com

parameters.content:
## Score and route GoHighLevel leads with Gemini, Slack and Monday.com

Automatically scores every new GoHighLevel (GHL) lead from 1 to 10 with Google Gemini, then routes it by score. Hot leads trigger an urgent Slack alert, a GHL tag, and a Monday.com task. Warm leads get a Slack post and a nurture tag. Cold leads get a low-priority tag.

### How it works
1. GHL sends a webhook when a contact is created or changes stage, and the workflow replies 200 OK immediately
2. The Workflow Configuration node holds your channel IDs, board ID, and company name
3. A Code node normalizes the contact fields (name, source, budget, timeline, property interest, message)
4. Gemini scores the lead and returns JSON with score, reasoning, and a recommended next step
5. A Code node parses the result and sets the tier: Hot (8-10), Warm (5-7), Cold (1-4)
6. A Switch node sends the lead down the Hot, Warm, or Cold path
7. Each path posts to Slack where relevant and adds score tags to the GHL contact

### Setup
1. In GHL, create a workflow with a Webhook action (trigger: Contact Created and/or Pipeline Stage Changed) that calls this workflow's production webhook URL
2. Create an HTTP Header Auth credential for GHL (name: Authorization, value: Bearer YOUR_GHL_TOKEN) and assign it to the three Update GHL nodes
3. Connect your Google Gemini (PaLM) API credential to the Gemini model node
4. Create an HTTP Header Auth credential for Monday.com (name: Authorization, value: YOUR_MONDAY_TOKEN) and assign it to the Monday.com node
5. Open the Workflow Configuration node and set your Slack channel IDs, Monday board ID, status column ID and label, and company name
6. Connect a Slack OAuth2 credential to both Slack nodes, then activate the workflow

### Customization
- Edit the scoring criteria in the Gemini prompt to match your ideal client profile
- Change the score thresholds in the Parse AI Score code node
- Add a WhatsApp or email node to the Hot path to ping the agent directly

### Notes
The webhook field names depend on your GHL workflow payload. Run one test, check the Webhook node output, and adjust the Normalize Lead Fields code if your field names differ.

## 1. Receive, configure and normalize

GHL posts here on a new contact or stage change. The workflow replies 200 OK right away, loads your settings, and normalizes the lead fields for scoring.

## 2. AI lead scoring

Gemini evaluates budget, timeline, property type, source quality, and message intent. It returns a score from 1 to 10 with a short reason, and a Code node sets the tier.

## 3. Route and act

The Switch node sends each lead down the Hot, Warm, or Cold path. Hot leads also create a Monday.com task. Every path adds score tags to the GHL contact.
